notes.text:
This update for libexif fixes the following issues

- CVE-2026-32775: Buffer overwrite via integer underflow in MakerNotes decoding (bsc#1259755).
- CVE-2026-40385: information disclosure and crashes via integer overflow in Nikon MakerNote handling (bsc#1262000).
- CVE-2026-40386: denial of service and information disclosure via integer underflow in MakerNote decoding
  (bsc#1262001).
